model: local protocol emulator; not a real-model intelligence evaluation

lanes.issue: read/write/edit/grep locaux et visibilité computer dans les deux sens
lanes.scenario: Guest read, write, edit, grep and bash on the private and shared volumes, with a second VM of the computer template mounting the same volumes
lanes.passWhen: The guest reads what the computer wrote, and the computer sees by polling what the guest wrote, on both volumes

guestToolResults.grep:
from-computer.txt:1: written by the computer
from-worker.txt:1: edited by the worker

observed.note: Visibility times run from the controller recording the native call that wrote (edit e1 for the private file, bash b1 for the shared one), which the harness reports before it runs the tool, to the host seeing the computer's poller exit. They include the tool's own run and E2B's command stream, so they bound the cross-VM delay from above.

lanes.issue: visibilité computer dans les deux sens (computer produit)
lanes.scenario: Lane b's exchange with the product's E2B computer of a team bot: a first run boots it through the executor with the volumes mounted, and the second run's guest exchanges files with it through its workspace link
lanes.passWhen: The first run's computer mounts the volumes and links its workspace to their root; the second run reuses that machine; the computer sees the guest's writes and the guest sees the computer's, on both volumes

guestToolResults.grep:
from-computer.txt:1: written by the computer
from-worker.txt:1: edited by the worker

observed.note: Visibility times run from the controller recording the native call that wrote (edit e1 for the private file, bash b1 for the shared one), which the harness reports before it runs the tool, to the host seeing the computer's poller exit. They include the tool's own run and E2B's command stream, so they bound the cross-VM delay from above.
